key_insight: A fully local, two-stage MedGemma pipeline can extract CRF data from clinical notes with strong evidence-bound behavior and no external API use.
clinical_relevance: This supports privacy-preserving, on-premise clinical NLP workflows that can help populate case report forms from unstructured EHR text.
method: Stage 1: binary presence classification to decide whether an item is present, absent, uncertain, or unknown.
Stage 2: value extraction only for items marked present, using item-specific few-shot in-context prompts.
Fully local deployment with domain-adapted MedGemma-27B, no fine-tuning or external APIs.
evidence_signal: On the official English test track, the system achieved a macro-F1 of 0.55 and ranked second among locally hosted open-source submissions.
watch_item: Performance is promising but still below frontier proprietary systems, so manual review may be needed for high-stakes CRF entries.
paper_title: sebis at CRF Filling 2026: A Two-Stage Local LLM Pipeline for Medical CRF Filling
